signIn.title: Sign in to Ronne AI Marketplace
signIn.subtitleBoth: Use your company's sign-in, or your email and password
signIn.setupDoneTitle: Ronne AI Marketplace is set up
signIn.setupDone: Sign in with the root account you just created.
signIn.forgotNote: Ask a root to reset your password in Users. If you're the only root, run {command} where Ronne AI Marketplace is installed. A lost authenticator, and its backup codes, is reset the same way: by a root, or for the only root, by that command.

errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts, wait a minute

again.expired: The sign-in took too long, or two-factor was reset. Sign in again.
again.too_many: Too many wrong codes. Sign in again.

sso.disabled: You can't sign in here with that account. Ask root to add you, or to allow your email's domain.
sso.not_allowed: You can't sign in here with that account. Ask root to add you, or to allow your email's domain.
sso.unverified_email: Your identity provider didn't say your email is verified, so you weren't signed in. Ask your administrator.
sso.invalid_response: Your identity provider's answer couldn't be checked, so you weren't signed in. Try again.
sso.provider_error: That provider didn't answer. Try again, or use your password.
sso.unavailable: That way of signing in isn't on. Use another, or ask your administrator.
sso.expired: The sign-in took too long, or was started in another browser. Try again.
sso.rate_limited: Too many attempts, wait a minute.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor sign-in
twoFactor.subtitle: Your password was right. Now the code from your phone.
twoFactor.lost: Lost your phone? Use a backup code, or ask a root administrator to reset your two-factor sign-in.
twoFactor.backupHint: One of the ten codes you saved, such as 3fK9q-Lm2Xz.
twoFactor.useApp: Use a code from the app instead

errors.used: That code was already used. Wait for the next one from the app.
errors.locked: Too many wrong codes. Try again in 15 minutes.
errors.unreadable: Your two-factor sign-in can't be read on this server. Ask a root to reset it.

device.title: Sign in rmk
device.description: Approve the code rmk login --web printed, and rmk gets a token that acts as you.
device.hintTyped: Check that it's the code your terminal shows.
device.approved: <mono>{name}</mono> is signed in as you. Go back to your terminal; you can close this page. The token is listed in Access tokens, where you can revoke it.
device.denied: {name} gets no token. If you didn't run rmk login --web yourself, someone may have sent you the code: nothing was signed in.
device.warnTitle: Only approve if you just ran rmk login --web yourself
device.warn: Approving gives the terminal that asked a token that acts as you for 90 days.

errors.invalid_code: That code isn't valid or has expired. Run rmk login --web again.

device.retry: {minutes, plural, one {Try again in a minute.} other {Try again in # minutes.}}
